label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey. Two different first-hand users report 22 and 24 years of safe use, and the evidence log contains no direct or qualifying indirect evidence of explosive ordnance. The coded cancellation check passes; this remains a recommendation for sign-off.
flags: The area is 100% forest; the reports concern timber/firewood use and a regularly walked trail, so consider whether the safe-use evidence adequately covers the full area.
The nearest recorded past accident is 1–3 km away, not inside this area. The zone flag and survey priority indicate where to visit, not evidence of contamination.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E1; E2); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: We have cut firewood and timber here for 22 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E1.note: A first-hand woodcutter reports 22 years of safe use of the area.

E2.quote: A teacher said she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 24 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E2.note: A first-hand user of the area reports 24 years of regular safe passage across it.
